'''Domain Pekeen''' was a [[Domain]] among the [[Warrior caste]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. During the [[Defense of Mon Calamari (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Defense of Mon Calamari]], Domain Pekeen participated in the attack on the planet.<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>
